summary: A signed-in person is never asked to log in again: services resolve the existing session before rendering login entries and replace them with the signed-in account.
approvalBasis: The platform owner instructed on 2026-10-28 04:27 KST: '로그인 되어 있는 경우 다시 로그인 시도하지 않도록 해.'
adds: existing session resolved before any login entry
login UI only without a session or on explicit account switch
preserves: v1.27.4 user-initiated Google sign-in and visible signed-in state
rollback: Revert only the v1.27.5 additions while preserving v1.27.4.
